title: Login fails after password reset
body: Users cannot log in after resetting their passwords.

title: Add dark mode support
body: Please add an optional dark theme to the dashboard.

title: Update API documentation
body: The API documentation is missing pagination examples.

title: Possible SQL injection in search
body: User input appears to be inserted directly into a database query. This may allow unauthorized data access.

title: Dashboard returns HTTP 500
body: The production dashboard returns HTTP 500 for every user.

title: Add CSV export
body: Allow users to export report data as CSV files.

title: Typo in installation guide
body: The installation guide contains a spelling mistake in the setup section.

title: Application deletes saved records
body: After updating a record, several previously saved records disappear.

title: Add pagination to issue list
body: The issue list should support pagination when there are many issues.

title: Unclear notification behavior
body: Notifications sometimes behave strangely. I am not sure what triggers it.

title: Search returns incorrect results
body: Searching for an exact issue title returns unrelated issues.

title: Document environment variables
body: Add descriptions of the required environment variables to the README.

title: Add GitLab integration
body: Support GitLab repositories in addition to GitHub repositories.

title: CI workflow fails on every commit
body: The production deployment pipeline is blocked because the CI workflow fails on every commit.

title: Clarify API authentication examples
body: The authentication section does not explain how to pass a bearer token.

title: Add issue assignment suggestions
body: Suggest a suitable team member when a new issue is created.

title: Unexplained application crash
body: The app crashes occasionally. No reproduction steps or logs are available.

title: Report data is duplicated
body: The monthly report displays each transaction twice after the latest update.

title: Add webhook configuration guide
body: Provide a step-by-step guide for configuring repository webhooks.

title: Possible unauthorized access to private issues
body: A user without repository access may be able to retrieve private issue details through the API.
